review_scope: Source-level runtime/report-method review, nine targeted coordinator tests and ten human-gate tests; no live generation. The report builder has not yet executed and its future numerical result rows are not certified here.

checks.name: topic_alignment
checks.finding: The same public-source judgment to interpretation to stated decision to actual weight chain is retained. Common AI, common market, and early/late source timing remain the research comparison.

checks.name: fixed_common_context
checks.finding: load_bundle rebuilds exact assigned D0 messages from hash-bound common context and public source packet; L source identity stays hidden until F0.

checks.name: four_case_two_stage_design
checks.finding: Two pilot sources by E/L, own D0 per case, first F0 only, at most eight generation attempts; no main entrypoint.

checks.name: calculator_role
checks.finding: Actual raw draft arithmetic is support supplied to both procedures, not a strategy-setting comparator or target-weight generator.

checks.name: no_behavioral_heuristics
checks.finding: No new risk coefficient, target return, rating-to-weight conversion, semantic score, or forced source diversity is introduced.

checks.name: pre_output_human_gate
checks.finding: Human gate is checked in prepare, run, transport and worker validation; blank forms fail before model HTTP. Two attestations preserve original file hashes and reconciliation.

checks.name: pilot_then_main_review
checks.finding: 129 relevant pilot fields are required per reviewer; the 99 main-only fields may remain null until main review. Uncertainty or similar source meaning is permitted.

checks.name: readability_not_success_censoring
checks.finding: Raw-sum failures and wrong output citations do not prohibit a structurally readable draft from proceeding to F0.

checks.name: structural_failure_denominators
checks.finding: Unreadable drafts skip their dependent F0 while other prespecified cases remain eligible; infrastructure/integrity incidents stop later cases and preserve not-attempted statuses.

checks.name: no_retry_or_repair
checks.finding: Exclusive output reservation and execution marker prevent retry/resume; no post-F0 repair or replacement of missing/invalid allocations.

checks.name: evidence_visibility
checks.finding: Exact body reconstruction rejects L source injection and controller metadata in model messages. Evaluator forms and cross-source contrast matrices remain outside requests.

checks.name: capacity_scope
checks.finding: Native counting applies to the exact actual request plus full allowed output; unknown future F0 is not claimed bounded. This remains a pre-main requirement, not a completed feasibility guarantee.

checks.name: engineering_counts_separate
checks.finding: Report builder labels synthetic CPU calls separately from zero pilot/main generations; synthetic maximum 32 output tokens cannot forecast full 8192-token task latency.

checks.name: engineering_setting_status
checks.finding: CPU threads, context and deadline are engineering choices rather than claimed paper-optimal behavioral conditions. No empirical inference comes from CPU probes.

checks.name: human_completion_not_fabricated
checks.finding: Delivered forms remain blank and report human review/freeze false. Software validates completeness and hashes, not human identity or semantic truth.

checks.name: research_scope_limits
checks.finding: Two documents, one model, one common market snapshot remain finite descriptive cases; no profitability, market-wide harmful convergence or pure anchoring claim.

open_findings.finding: Normal coordinator uses its actual raw D0, but direct F0 worker specs only check internal text consistency. They do not yet bind that raw string to the same run/case completed D0 response artifact. A copied or synthetic raw_draft could satisfy the first revision spec validator.
open_findings.required_change: Bind F0 to exact same-run/same-case D0 response, worker request/spec, worker summary and supervisor evidence with SHA checks and single completed D0 attempt; fail closed before render/generation if missing or mismatched.
open_findings.resolution_status: runtime agent implementing; initial code snapshot retained

additional_review_notes: Final root audit should compare each actual diagnostic request body with its declared spec and check issuer words with word boundaries, not substring ubs matching.
Final root audit must bind the new r2 method/technical/code receipts after the lineage change; this initial receipt is not final approval.
